requirement_text.REQ-428: Third MOB-4 requirement. Task routes (lib/letflow/routers/tasks.ex): GET /api/v1/tasks/inbox, GET /api/v1/tasks/:id, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/claim, POST /api/v1/tasks/:id/complete. The task form is resolved through REQ-424's pinned resolver and rendered by REQ-427's form renderer; never the active version. Process-instance renderer: read-only view of GET /api/v1/instances/:id and /api/v1/instances/:id/timeline (lib/letflow/routers/instances.ex) -- status, current step, timeline. No cancel/rebind/advance actions (not in MOB-4). All screens use REQ-426's six-state wrapper; claim/complete errors (409 already claimed, 403, 422) map to its states.

task.description: Hard gate per WF-02 Step 2d. Read git diff main...HEAD on this branch (feature/WF02-REQ428-20261001). Check against .claude/agents/reviewer.md's four questions (idiomatic vs. crutch, supervision, type-safety gaps, scope creep) and docs/anti-patterns.md. Pay particular attention to: (1) MOBILE-DEV's self-reported deviation that TaskInboxController.client is typed PostCapableHttpGateway rather than the design doc's bare HttpGateway -- confirm this is a sound interface-typing correction (claim needs POST capability) and not an undocumented scope change; (2) the claim that renderer_state.dart's rendererStateForError already has a ConflictError arm, contradicting the design doc's OQ-3 -- confirm by reading the actual source; (3) that TaskClaimOutcome is deliberately kept outside RendererState (mirroring REQ-427's precedent for submit outcomes) rather than being a crutch; (4) zero cancel/rebind/reconstruct/advance-timer code exists anywhere in the new process.dart. FAIL if a genuine crutch, broken invariant, or scope creep is found; otherwise PASS with any non-blocking notes recorded.
acceptance_criteria: Diff matches the approved design (req428-task-and-instance-renderer.md) with no undocumented scope expansion
TaskClaimOutcome / RendererState separation is sound, not a workaround
No cancel/rebind/advance/reconstruct action present anywhere in the new instance-screen code
